name: Binh Tay Market
kicker: The wholesale hall in Chợ Lớn
summary: Wholesale hall in Chợ Lớn: walk the clock gate and the trading floor on the neighborhood circuit. The yellow gate carries the name Chợ Bình Tây. Pair the hall with Thiên Hậu on the same walk out from the cathedral square. The second frame is the stairs and the wholesale floor.
fee: Check on arrival. No fee was printed.
getThere: With the Chợ Lớn walk, a ride from the cathedral square. Check on arrival.
heroCaption: The yellow gate, the clock, and the name Chợ Bình Tây

notice.title: Use this hall’s own board
notice.body: Bến Thành’s free line and its split clock are for the central market. This wholesale hall in Chợ Lớn has its own door.

body: Chợ Lớn is the Chinese neighborhood the southern visitor page tells you to walk, and Bình Tây is the wholesale center on that walk. The photograph is the gate: the clock and the words Chợ Bình Tây. A street number was left off the pages that name the hall.

The second photograph is the interior, stairs and the wholesale floor. The unnamed food street in District 5 is a different stop, because that street’s name is not printed. Pair the hall with Thiên Hậu.
